title: 국립중앙도서관과 그 소속 도서관 이용규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Days Closed)
(1) Libraries shall be closed on the following days:
1. Public holidays observed by government offices, excluding Sundays: Provided, That libraries shall be closed on Sundays that fall during the Lunar New Year or Chuseok holiday period;
2. The second and fourth Mondays of each month;
3. Days on which a library director deems closure necessary for organizing books or for other reasons.
(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1) 1, the National Library for Children and Young Adults shall not be closed on May 5 (Children's Day).
(3) A library director shall post advance notice of closure days under paragraph (1) 3.
